command:
echo @@BATTERY
dumpsys battery
echo @@THERMAL
dumpsys thermalservice
for p in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*; do
 echo "@@POLICY ${p##*/}"
 for f in scaling_cur_freq scaling_min_freq scaling_max_freq cpuinfo_max_freq scaling_governor related_cpus; do
  printf '%s=' "$f"; cat "$p/$f"
 done
done
echo @@MEMORY
cat /proc/meminfo
echo @@LOAD
cat /proc/loadavg
echo @@POWER
dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state='
echo @@GPU_SYSFS
for f in /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpuclk /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/cur_freq /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpubusy; do
 printf '%s=' "$f"; cat "$f"
done
true
